headline: The Bull Case For Brown & Brown (BRO) Could Change Following Q2 2026 Earnings Miss And Dividend Reaffirmation
summary: Brown & Brown, Inc. recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, with revenue rising to US$1,676 million and net income reaching US$288 million, alongside modest year-on-year gains in both basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations. Despite this strong year-on-year performance and a reaffirmed quarterly dividend of US$0.1650 per share, the company slightly missed consensus expectations on revenue and earnings, prompting investors to reassess how growth quality and...
